clips.title: The story
paras: At the Venture Company console, you uncover the elusive samophlange and carry it to Ratchet. You have shut down the controls and their defenses; now the delicate device is ready for Sputtervalve to examine.

Behind the Venture Company console's faceplate, wiring and purposeless tubing crowd around strange engineering. Deep inside lies the samophlange, a core component that has baffled engineers across the region. With a firm tug, you free the device from its housing and carry it back to the goblin who began the recovery effort.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, you're back, friend! Do you have the samophlange?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is... Er... Interesting... Yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.
But, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
